limitations_declared_before_training: TEST-C contains only Normal and DDoS within this controlled cohort.
J5-C3 therefore evaluates a late-file/distribution shift, not held-out Reconnaissance or universal OOD generalization.
The underlying 74 source files were used in earlier J5 experiments; TEST-C is a newly pre-specified evaluation fold, not a previously unseen external dataset.
primary_policy_objective: Maximize benign Fast-Path rate on VAL-C subject to attack Fast-Path rate <= 1%.
purpose: Controlled late-file DDoS-dominant evaluation of baseline versus adaptive DPI gating.
selection_rule: No model predictions were used to choose the 50/12/12 block split.
source_population: Previously constructed 104,973-flow controlled BoT-IoT cohort; this is a new deterministic repartition, not a new external dataset.
test_opening_rule: TEST-C predictions and performance must not be computed until the model, Cog mechanism, baseline policy, adaptive policy, and their artifact hashes have been frozen.
